claim: Validation-calibrated risk proxy improves generalized difference estimator over raw confidence proxy at equal PPS acquisition.
Discriminative raw uncertainty proxy improves augmented estimator over validation-only constant proxy.
Constant validated risk proxy is safer than deliberately inverted proxy for augmented estimation.
Aggressive uncertainty-weighted probability-proportional sampling improves over mild oversampling under an augmented estimator.
Aggressive uncertainty sampling improves Horvitz-Thompson population risk estimation relative to mild probability oversampling.
